title: funds.csv
description: Every fund of one government, with its role and a plain description. Code is the org-code prefix the book uses for the fund (empty for the tax-funded main fund). Roles: primary = the fund the site opens on and the pages treat as the tax-funded one; enterprise = a self-supporting utility; special = a small fund with its own revenue; capital = a capital-projects fund; reserve = a savings fund shown last in a list. printed_names are the words a printed roll-up label uses for the fund (semicolon-separated, lower case), so a printed total can be matched to its fund.

code_prefix.description: The org-code prefix the book uses for this fund; empty for the main fund (its codes are 7 digits).

name.description: The fund's name, as the site shows it.

role.description: primary = the fund the site opens on and the pages treat as tax-funded; enterprise = a self-supporting utility; special = a small fund with its own revenue; capital = a capital-projects fund; reserve = a savings fund.

paid_by.description: Who pays for the fund's spending (fees, taxes, a grant), in a few words.

description.description: What the fund is for, in one sentence for readers.
examples: Wastewater collection, pumping stations and treatment.

printed_names.description: Words a printed roll-up label uses for this fund, lower case and semicolon-separated (matched anywhere in the label). More specific words come first.
